description: This file contains a PHP class implementing a PostgreSQL 7 driver for the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It defines a database driver class (`ADODB_postgres7`) with methods for executing SQL queries, retrieving metadata, and handling character sets, as well as related recordset classes extending a base PostgreSQL recordset class. The file is specific to PostgreSQL 7 and above, implementing driver-specific logic for schema queries, limits, and foreign keys.

classes.name: ADODB_postgres7
classes.description: Database driver class for PostgreSQL 7 in the ADOdb library, providing methods to execute SQL, retrieve metadata, manage character sets, and handle schema-specific queries.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_postgres7
classes.description: Recordset class extending PostgreSQL 6 recordset to handle result sets for PostgreSQL 7, with optimized move next logic.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_assoc_postgres7
classes.description: Specialized recordset class with associative array features for PostgreSQL 7, extending the previous recordset class.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes an SQL query with limit and offset support, compatible with PostgreSQL 7's syntax.

methods.name: _generateMetaColumnsSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for retrieving meta column information, schema-aware if specified.

methods.name: metaForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign key constraints for a specified table.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query with parameter binding support, using pg_query_params.

methods.name: getCharSet
methods.description: Retrieves the current client connection character set.

methods.name: setCharSet
methods.description: Sets the client connection character set.
